source.acip: DE'I CHA SHAS GCIG GIS NYER LEN DANG , MI'I LAS KYIS LHAN CIG BYED RKYEN BYAS PA LA BRTEN NAS DE'I CHA SHAS GCIG GI RIGS 'DRA PHYI MA CHUR SKYE BA DANG ,
source.wylie: de'i cha shas gcig gis nyer len dang , mi'i las kyis lhan cig byed rkyen byas pa la brten nas de'i cha shas gcig gi rigs 'dra phyi ma chur skye ba dang
source.english: Another part of the glass of water again provides a material cause, and the karma of the human provides a contributing factor; and then based on both of these the later continuation of one part of the glass of water starts being water.
